content.title: Review recent portfolio activity
content.description: An investment professional reviews a recent-activity feed of portfolio events, scans timestamps, event types, assets, values, and statuses, and uses the table as a compact chronological record of trading, alerts, dividends, and rebalancing actions.
content.value: Shows the latest portfolio and system events in a single timeline-oriented table.
criteria: Recent activity columns are TIME, TYPE, DESCRIPTION, ASSET, VALUE, and STATUS.
Sample activity types include BUY, SELL, ALERT, DIVIDEND, and REBALANCE, with statuses including COMPLETED and OPEN.
Statuses are displayed as compact pills.
